name: Henry A. Kissinger

life_arc.events: Born in Fürth; grew up in a Jewish family during the rise of Nazism.
Emigrated to the United States; served in the U.S. Army; became a citizen.
Harvard career; developed ideas on balance of power, nuclear strategy and international order.
Nixon adviser; Vietnam backchannel, China opening and Soviet détente.
Paris Peace Accords; October 1973 crisis; shuttle diplomacy; détente; Helsinki process.
Left government; advised presidents and institutions; wrote major works on diplomacy.
Continued commentary, consulting and diplomatic engagement until death in 2023.

failure_modes: short-term strategic success with adverse long-term outcomes
sources: U.S. Office of the Historian / FRUS
